 Bey scores 23, Fears posts triple-double as Pelicans beat Warriors 115-94 
 By Jamarcus Fitzpatrick Published : Nov. 16, 2026 at 9:49 PM CST | Updated : 35 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google NEW ORLEANS, La. (Acadiana News First) - Saddiq Bey scored 23 points and Jeremiah Fears had a triple-double as the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Golden State Warriors 115-94 on Monday.
 Fears finished with 19 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists for New Orleans, which led by as many as 31 points and never trailed. Bey made five 3-pointers, all in the first half.
 Derik Queen added 17 points and 10 rebounds off the bench, while Zion Williamson scored 16 points. Yves Missi had 14 rebounds, including seven on the offensive glass.
 The Pelicans took control early, outscoring Golden State 35-11 in the first quarter. The Warriors made just two of their 18 field-goal attempts in the period and went 1 for 13 from 3-point range.
 New Orleans led 61-36 at halftime and carried a 93-65 advantage into the fourth quarter.
 Yaxel Lendeborg led Golden State with 28 points and eight rebounds. Brandin Podziemski scored 15 points, and Gui Santos and Will Richard added 12 and 11, respectively.
 The Pelicans shot 41.8% from the field and made 15 of 40 3-point attempts. The Warriors shot 33.3% overall and made 11 of 46 from beyond the arc. New Orleans outrebounded Golden State 58-50 and scored 27 points off 15 Warriors turnovers.
 The Pelicans improved to 5-10, while the Warriors fell to 8-6.
